## Rules

| ID | Name | Description | Fixable |
| -- | ---- | ----------- | ------- |
| `Y001` | `indentation` | Indentation must use spaces, consistently (2 by default). | ✅ |
| `Y002` | `trailing-spaces` | Lines must not contain trailing whitespace. | ✅ |
| `Y003` | `tabs` | Tab characters are not allowed for indentation. | ✅ |
| `Y004` | `duplicate-keys` | A mapping must not contain the same key twice. | ❌ |
| `Y005` | `missing-document-start` | Multi-document files should start with `---`. | ✅ |
| `Y006` | `trailing-newline` | File must end with exactly one newline. | ✅ |
| `Y007` | `empty-document` | Empty documents are not allowed. | ❌ |
| `Y008` | `line-length` | Lines must not exceed the configured maximum length. | ❌ |
| `Y009` | `key-order` | Mapping keys should be in alphabetical order. | ✅ |
| `Y010` | `truthy-values` | Use `true`/`false` instead of `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`. | ✅ |
| `Y011` | `quoted-strings` | Strings containing special characters must be quoted. | ❌ |
| `Y012` | `comments-spacing` | Comments must start with `# ` (a space after the hash). | ✅ |
| `Y013` | `empty-lines` | No more than one consecutive blank line. | ✅ |
| `Y014` | `anchors` | Anchors and aliases must have descriptive names. | ❌ |
| `Y015` | `merge-keys` | Merge keys (`<<`) are discouraged. | ❌ |
| `Y016` | `long-key` | Keys must not exceed the configured maximum length. | ❌ |
| `Y017` | `deprecated-doc-marker` | `...` end-of-document markers are deprecated. | ✅ |
| `Y018` | `unquoted-colon` | Values containing `: ` must be quoted. | ❌ |
| `Y019` | `null-values` | Prefer an explicit `null` over an empty value. | ✅ |
| `Y020` | `file-name` | File names must be lowercase and use dashes. | ❌ |

## Configuration

flak looks for a `.flak.yml` (or `.flak.yaml`, `flak.yml`) in the current directory and walks up the tree. It can also be placed at the repository root for shared settings.

```yaml
# .flak.yml
version: 1

lint:
  # Files/directories to skip.
  exclude:
    - "**/vendor/**"
    - "**/node_modules/**"
    - "**/*.generated.yaml"
    - "**/fixtures/**"

  # Only lint files matching these globs.
  include:
    - "**/*.yml"
    - "**/*.yaml"

  # Follow symlinks while walking directories.
  follow-symlinks: false

  # Maximum number of problems reported per file (0 = unlimited).
  max-issues-per-file: 0

rules:
  # Enable or disable individual rules.
  Y001:
    enabled: true
    indent: 2
  Y002:
    enabled: true
  Y008:
    enabled: true
    max-line-length: 120
  Y009:
    enabled: false
  Y014:
    enabled: true
    pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"

output:
  format: "stylish"   # stylish | compact | json | junit | sarif | github
  color: "auto"       # auto | always | never

severity:
  default: "warning"  # error | warning | info
```

### Inline configuration

Override rules for a single file with a comment at the top of the file:

```yaml
# flak:disable Y008
# flak:enable Y009
# flak:disable-next-line Y004
```

### Project layout


### Writing a rule

```go
package rules

import "github.com/yourorg/flak/internal/lint"

type NoTabs struct{}

func (NoTabs) ID() string   { return "Y003" }
func (NoTabs) Name() string { return "tabs" }

func (NoTabs) Check(f *lint.File) []lint.Problem {
    var problems []lint.Problem
    for _, line := range f.Lines {
        if idx := indexByte(line, '\t'); idx >= 0 {
            problems = append(problems, lint.Problem{
                Line:     line.Number,
                Column:   idx + 1,
                Rule:     "Y003",
                Message:  "tab character used for indentation",
                Fixable:  true,
                SuggestedFix: lint.ReplaceTabs(line.Text, f.Config.Indent),
            })
        }
    }
    return problems
}
```

Register it in `internal/rules/registry.go`, then add a fixture under `testdata/` and a test case.

## Features

- **Blazing fast** — parallel, multi-core linting of entire directory trees.
- **50+ built-in rules** covering formatting, structure, security, and Kubernetes/Docker Compose conventions.
- **Auto-fix** — `--fix` rewrites files in place for all fixable rules.
- **Configurable** — TOML config file, per-directory overrides, and inline `# flak:` directives.
- **YAML 1.2 aware** — understands anchors, aliases, merge keys, multi-document streams, and block scalars.
- **Multiple output formats** — human-readable text, `json`, `junit` XML, and GitHub Actions annotations.
- **Zero required dependencies** for the core linter.

## Installation

### pipx (recommended)

```console
$ pipx install flak
```

### pip

```console
$ python -m pip install flak
```

### From source

```console
$ git clone https://github.com/example/flak.git
```

## Quick start

Lint every YAML file in the current directory:

```console
$ flak .
```

Lint specific files:

```console
$ flak config/app.yaml k8s/
```

Fix issues in place:

```console
$ flak --fix .
```

Check formatting only (no style rules):

```console
$ flak --select E,W .
```

## Usage

```console
$ flak [OPTIONS] [PATH ...]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p`, `--path` | Additional path to lint (repeatable). |
| `-c`, `--config` | Path to a config file (default: `flak.toml`, `.flak.toml`). |
| `--select` | Comma-separated list of rule codes to enable (e.g. `F001,F007`). |
| `--ignore` | Comma-separated list of rule codes to disable. |
| `--extend-ignore` | Additional ignores, appended to the config file's ignores. |
| `--fix` | Apply automatic fixes to files in place. |
| `--diff` | Print a diff of the fixes that would be applied (implies no writes). |
| `--format` | Output format: `text`, `json`, `junit`, `github`. Default: `text`. |
| `--output-file` | Write report to a file instead of stdout. |
| `--exclude` | Glob patterns to skip (repeatable). |
| `--stdin-filename` | Lint content read from stdin, using the given name for reporting. |
| `--jobs` | Number of parallel workers. Default: number of CPUs. |
| `--no-cache` | Disable the result cache. |
| `--show-source` | Print the offending source line for each violation. |
| `--statistics` | Print a summary count per rule. |
| `--version` | Show the version and exit. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Increase log verbosity (repeatable). |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | Only print errors. |

Run `flak --help` for the full list.

## Rules

Rules are grouped by prefix. `*` marks a rule that can be fixed automatically with `--fix`.

### Errors (E)

| Code | Description | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `E001` | File is not valid YAML. | |
| `E002` | Duplicate mapping key. | |
| `E003` | Undefined alias / anchor not found. | |
| `E004` | Tab character used for indentation. | |
| `E005` | Inconsistent indentation within a mapping. | * |
| `E006` | Block scalar indentation is invalid. | |
| `E007` | Merge key (`<<`) used with a non-mapping value. | |

### Warnings (W)

| Code | Description | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `W001` | File contains no document. | |
| `W002` | Trailing whitespace. | * |
| `W003` | File does not end with a newline. | * |
| `W004` | Missing `---` document start marker. | * |
| `W005` | Multiple documents not separated by a blank line. | * |
| `W006` | Comment is missing a space after `#`. | * |
| `W007` | Comment block has no space before the `#`. | * |
| `W008` | Key contains trailing whitespace. | * |
| `W009` | Flow mapping/sequence is too long. | |
| `W010` | Empty document (`---` followed by nothing). | |

### Style (F)

| Code | Description | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `F001` | Line exceeds the configured maximum length. | |
| `F002` | Truthy value used where a boolean is expected. | * |
| `F003` | Key ordering does not match the configured order. | * |
| `F004` | Redundant quotes around a plain scalar. | * |
| `F005` | Unnecessary explicit `null` value. | * |
| `F006` | Empty value should be omitted or explicitly `null`. | |
| `F007` | Deprecated YAML syntax (e.g. `y`/`n` for booleans). | * |
| `F008` | Anchor defined but never used. | |
| `F009` | Alias used more than once — consider an anchor-free structure. | |
| `F010` | Consistent indentation should use spaces only. | * |

### Kubernetes (K)

| Code | Description | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `K001` | `apiVersion` should precede `kind`. | * |
| `K002` | `kind` is missing. | |
| `K003` | `metadata.name` is missing. | |
| `K004` | `image` tag is missing (`latest` implied). | |
| `K005` | `image` uses a mutable `latest` tag. | |
| `K006` | `containerPort` should be a string. | * |
| `K007` | `resources.limits` and `resources.requests` are inconsistent. | |

### Docker Compose (C)

| Code | Description | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `C001` | Service is missing `image` or `build`. | |
| `C002` | `version` key is obsolete in Compose Specification. | * |
| `C003` | `depends_on` should use the long syntax. | |
| `C004` | Port mapping is missing a protocol. | * |

### GitHub Actions (G)

| Code | Description | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `G001` | Workflow is missing `on:` trigger. | |
| `G002` | Action is not pinned to a full commit SHA. | |
| `G003` | `run:` step uses an unpinned third-party action. | |
| `G004` | Workflow file is not named `*.yml`/`*.yaml` under `.github/workflows`. | |

## Configuration

`flak` looks for `flak.toml` (or `.flak.toml`) in the current directory and walks up the tree to the project root.

```toml
# flak.toml

[lint]
max-line-length = 100
select = ["E", "W", "F", "K"]
ignore = ["W009", "F003"]
exclude = [
    "vendor/**",
    "**/node_modules/**",
    "*.min.yaml",
]

[format]
indent = 2
quote-style = "single"      # single | double | preserve
document-start = true
sort-keys = false

[fix]
enabled = true
```

### Per-directory configuration

Nested `flak.toml` files override the parent configuration for files in their directory:

```toml
# k8s/flak.toml
[lint]
select = ["E", "K"]
max-line-length = 120
```

### Per-file ignores

In `flak.toml`:

```toml
[lint]
per-file-ignores = [
    "tests/fixtures/**" = ["E001", "W004"],
    "**/generated.yaml" = ["F001"],
]
```

## Inline directives

Disable rules for a single line:

```yaml
port: 8080  # flak: disable=F001
```

Disable rules for a whole file:

```yaml
# flak: file-ignore=W004,F003
---
foo: bar
```

Enable a rule that is globally disabled:

```yaml
value: 1  # flak: enable=F001
```

## Auto-fixing

```console
$ flak --fix .
```

Fixable rules are rewritten in place; unfixable violations are still reported. Use `--diff` to preview:

```console
$ flak --diff config/app.yaml
--- config/app.yaml
+++ config/app.yaml
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 name:   my-app
-enabled: yes
+enabled: true
```

## Output formats

```console
$ flak --format json .
[
  {
    "file": "k8s/deployment.yaml",
    "line": 31,
    "column": 5,
    "code": "F002",
    "message": "truthy value used for key 'enabled'",
    "fixable": true
  }
]
```

Supported formats: `text` (default), `json`, `junit`, `github`.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | No violations found. |
| `1` | Violations were found. |
| `2` | An error occurred (bad config, unreadable file, invalid CLI usage). |

## Editor & CI integration

### GitHub Actions

```yaml
name: lint-yaml

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  flak:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: example/flak-action@v1
```

### Pre-commit

```yaml
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/example/flak
    rev: v1.4.0
    hooks:
      - id: flak
        args: ["--fix"]
```

### Vim (ALE)

```vim
let g:ale_flak_executable = 'flak'
```

### VS Code

Set `yaml.validate` to `false` and use the generic linting integration with `flak --format json`.

## Python API

```python
from flak import lint_file, lint_text, Config

config = Config.from_path("flak.toml")

for issue in lint_file("k8s/deployment.yaml", config=config):
    print(issue.code, issue.line, issue.message)

# Lint an in-memory string
issues = lint_text("foo: bar\n", filename="example.yaml", config=config)
```

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome!

1. Fork the repository and create a feature branch.
2. Install development dependencies: `python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'`.
3. Add or update tests: `pytest`.
4. Run the linter on itself: `flak .`.
5. Open a pull request describing the change.

New rules should include:

- A unique code and a short, actionable message.
- Documentation in `docs/rules/<code>.md`.
- Tests covering both the failing and passing cases.
- A `fixable` implementation if the change is safe to apply automatically.

# paw 🐾

A tiny, accessible collection of 12 unstyled-ish React UI primitives. Zero dependencies, tree-shakeable, and designed to be styled your way.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/paw.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/paw)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![bundle size](https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/paw.svg)](https://bundlephobia.com/package/paw)

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install paw
# or
pnpm add paw
# or
yarn add paw
```

Requires React 18+.

```bash
npm install paw react react-dom
```

---

## Quick start

```tsx
import { Button, Input, Badge } from 'paw';
import 'paw/styles.css';

export function Example() {
  return (
    <form onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
      <Input id="email" name="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />

      <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
        Sign up
      </Button>

      <Badge tone="success">Free plan</Badge>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Every component is a named export — import only what you use.

---

## The 12 primitives

| Component | Description | Import |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Button` | Clickable action with variants and loading state | `import { Button } from 'paw'` |
| `Input` | Single-line text field | `import { Input } from 'paw'` |
| `Textarea` | Multi-line text field | `import { Textarea } from 'paw'` |
| `Select` | Native select with a styled chevron | `import { Select } from 'paw'` |
| `Checkbox` | Checkbox with indeterminate support | `import { Checkbox } from 'paw'` |
| `Radio` | Radio button in a `RadioGroup` | `import { Radio, RadioGroup } from 'paw'` |
| `Switch` | Toggle for immediate on/off changes | `import { Switch } from 'paw'` |
| `Badge` | Small status label | `import { Badge } from 'paw'` |
| `Avatar` | Image with initials fallback | `import { Avatar } from 'paw'` |
| `Spinner` | Indeterminate loading indicator | `import { Spinner } from 'paw'` |
| `Progress` | Determinate progress bar | `import { Progress } from 'paw'` |
| `Tooltip` | Hover/focus tooltip | `import { Tooltip } from 'paw'` |

---

## Component API

### Button

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md" loading={false} disabled={false} fullWidth>
  Save
</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | Visual style |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control size |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and disables the button |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches to the container width |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables interaction |

Extends `React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>`.

### Input

```tsx
<Input label="Email" error="That address looks invalid" hint="We'll never share it." />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Renders a `<label>` linked to the field |
| `hint` | `string` | — | Helper text below the field |
| `error` | `string` | — | Error message; sets `aria-invalid` |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control size |

Extends `React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>`.

### Textarea

```tsx
<Textarea label="Bio" rows={4} maxLength={280} showCount />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` / `hint` / `error` | `string` | — | Same as `Input` |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Visible rows |
| `showCount` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays `value.length / maxLength` |

### Select

```tsx
<Select label="Plan" options={[{ value: 'free', label: 'Free' }, { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro' }]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` | `[]` | Option list |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Disabled first option |
| `label` / `hint` / `error` | `string` | — | Same as `Input` |

### Checkbox

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Subscribe to updates" checked={checked} onChange={setChecked} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the mixed state |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onChange` | — | — | Standard controlled/uncontrolled usage |

### Radio & RadioGroup

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Shipping" value={value} onChange={setValue} name="shipping">
  <Radio value="standard" label="Standard" />
  <Radio value="express" label="Express" />
</RadioGroup>
```

`RadioGroup` manages roving focus and arrow-key navigation; `Radio` accepts `value`, `label`, and `disabled`.

### Switch

```tsx
<Switch label="Dark mode" checked={dark} onChange={setDark} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Track size |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onChange` | — | — | Standard controlled/uncontrolled usage |

### Badge

```tsx
<Badge tone="success" variant="soft">Active</Badge>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'info'` | `'neutral'` | Semantic color |
| `variant` | `'soft' \| 'solid' \| 'outline'` | `'soft'` | Visual style |
| `dot` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a leading status dot |

### Avatar

```tsx
<Avatar src="/me.png" name="Ada Lovelace" size="lg" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image URL; falls back to initials on error |
| `name` | `string` | — | Used for initials and `alt` text |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` | Avatar size |
| `shape` | `'circle' \| 'square'` | `'circle'` | Avatar shape |

### Spinner

```tsx
<Spinner size="md" label="Loading…" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Spinner size |
| `label` | `string` | `'Loading'` | Screen-reader label |

### Progress

```tsx
<Progress value={64} max={100} label="Uploading" showValue />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | `0` | Current progress |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Upper bound |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the percentage |

### Tooltip

```tsx
<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" placement="top">
  <button>Copy</button>
</Tooltip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `ReactNode` | — | Tooltip body |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | `'top'` | Position |
| `delay` | `number` | `120` | Open delay in ms |

---

## Theming

`paw` ships with a single stylesheet built entirely on CSS custom properties. Override any token in your own CSS:

```css

  --paw-color-warning: #d97706;

  --paw-color-text: #111827;
  --paw-color-muted: #6b7280;
  --paw-color-border: #e5e7eb;
  --paw-color-surface: #ffffff;
  --paw-color-focus: #6d28d9;

  --paw-radius-sm: 4px;
  --paw-radius-md: 8px;
  --paw-radius-lg: 12px;
  --paw-radius-full: 9999px;

  --paw-space-1: 4px;
  --paw-space-2: 8px;
  --paw-space-3: 12px;
  --paw-space-4: 16px;

  --paw-font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --paw-font-size-sm: 13px;
```

runs.output:
# paw

> Tiny, accessible React primitives. Bite-sized building blocks for the parts of your UI you shouldn't have to reinvent.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/paw.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/paw)
[![bundle size](https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/paw.svg)](https://bundlephobia.com/package/paw)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](#license)

---

## Why paw?

Most apps need the same dozen widgets: a button, a text field, a checkbox, a tooltip. Every project ends up rewriting them, slightly differently, with subtly different bugs.

**paw** gives you those twelve primitives — and nothing else.

- 🧩 **Small surface area.** Twelve components, each with a short, predictable API.
- 🪶 **Tiny.** ~4.2 kB gzipped, tree-shakeable, zero runtime dependencies.
- ♿ **Accessible by default.** WAI-ARIA roles, keyboard support, and focus management are built in, not bolted on.
- 🎨 **Themeable with CSS variables.** Light and dark, no runtime styling engine.
- 🧱 **Unstyled core, styled defaults.** Every component ships with sensible styles you can override, and a `unstyled` prop when you want full control.

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install paw
# or
pnpm add paw
yarn add paw
```

Requires React 18 or 19.

```bash
npm install peerDeps react react-dom
```

---

## Quick start

```jsx
import { Button, Input, Field } from 'paw';
import 'paw/styles.css';

function Example() {
  return (
    <form onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <Field label="Email" htmlFor="email">
        <Input id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
      </Field>

      <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
        Subscribe
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Import the stylesheet once, anywhere in your app:

```jsx
import 'paw/styles.css';
```

---

## The twelve components

| Component | Import | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Button** | `import { Button } from 'paw'` | Clickable action with variants and loading state |
| **Input** | `import { Input } from 'paw'` | Single-line text field |
| **Textarea** | `import { Textarea } from 'paw'` | Multi-line text field with auto-resize |
| **Field** | `import { Field } from 'paw'` | Label + description + error wrapper for any control |
| **Checkbox** | `import { Checkbox } from 'paw'` | Boolean or indeterminate selection |
| **RadioGroup** | `import { RadioGroup } from 'paw'` | Mutually exclusive choice set |
| **Switch** | `import { Switch } from 'paw'` | Immediate on/off toggle |
| **Select** | `import { Select } from 'paw'` | Native select with custom styling |
| **Slider** | `import { Slider } from 'paw'` | Numeric value on a range |
| **Badge** | `import { Badge } from 'paw'` | Small status or count label |
| **Avatar** | `import { Avatar } from 'paw'` | User image with initials fallback |
| **Tooltip** | `import { Tooltip } from 'paw'` | Contextual hint on hover or focus |

---

## Component examples

### Button

```jsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md">Save changes</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={openMenu}>Menu</Button>
<Button variant="danger" loading>Saving…</Button>
<Button as="a" href="/docs">Read the docs</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | `'secondary'` | Visual weight |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy`, disables input |
| `as` | `ElementType` | `'button'` | Render as another element (`'a'`, `Link`, …) |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | |

### Input & Field

```jsx
<Field
  label="Password"
  description="At least 12 characters."
  error={error}
>
  <Input type="password" value={value} onChange={setValue} required />
</Field>
```

`Field` renders the `<label>`, optional description, and error message, and wires up `aria-describedby` / `aria-invalid` for you.

### Checkbox

```jsx
<Checkbox checked={checked} onChange={setChecked}>
  Email me about product updates
</Checkbox>

<Checkbox checked={some} indeterminate onChange={setSome}>
  Select all
</Checkbox>
```

### RadioGroup

```jsx
<RadioGroup
  name="plan"
  value={plan}
  onChange={setPlan}
  options={[
    { value: 'free', label: 'Free', description: '1 project' },
    { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'Unlimited projects' },
  ]}
/>
```

### Switch

```jsx
<Switch checked={enabled} onChange={setEnabled} label="Dark mode" />
```

### Select

```jsx
<Select
  value={country}
  onChange={setCountry}
  options={[
    { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
    { value: 'jp', label: 'Japan' },
  ]}
/>
```

### Slider

```jsx
<Slider min={0} max={100} step={5} value={volume} onChange={setVolume} />
```

### Badge

```jsx
<Badge tone="success">Active</Badge>
<Badge tone="danger" variant="solid">3 errors</Badge>
```

### Avatar

```jsx
<Avatar src="/img/ada.png" name="Ada Lovelace" size="lg" />
<Avatar name="Grace Hopper" /> {/* falls back to initials */}
```

### Tooltip

```jsx
<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard">
  <Button aria-label="Copy">⧉</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

---

## Theming

paw ships a single stylesheet driven by CSS custom properties. Override them anywhere:

```css
:root {
  --paw-color-primary: #4f46e5;
  --paw-color-primary-hover: #4338ca;
  --paw-color-danger: #dc2626;
  --paw-color-text: #111827;
  --paw-color-muted: #6b7280;
  --paw-color-border: #e5e7eb;
  --paw-color-surface: #ffffff;
  --paw-color-focus-ring: #4f46e5;

  --paw-radius-sm: 4px;
  --paw-radius-md: 8px;
  --paw-radius-full: 9999px;

  --paw-space-1: 4px;
  --paw-space-2: 8px;
  --paw-space-3: 12px;
  --paw-space-4: 16px;

  --paw-font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --paw-font-size-sm: 13px;
  --paw-font-size-md: 15px;

  --paw-shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08);
  --paw-transition: 120ms ease;
}
```

Dark mode:

```css
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --paw-color-text: #f3f4f6;
    --paw-color-surface: #111827;
    --paw-color-border: #374151;
    --paw-color-muted: #9ca3af;
  }
}
```

### Unstyled mode

Every component accepts `unstyled`, which strips paw's classes and leaves you with a bare, fully accessible element:

```jsx
<Button unstyled className="my-btn">Save</Button>
```

---

## Accessibility

paw is built on native HTML elements wherever possible, so browser behaviour comes for free.

- **Keyboard.** All interactive components are reachable and operable with `Tab`, `Shift+Tab`, `Enter`, `Space`, and arrow keys (radio groups and sliders use roving focus).
- **Focus.** A visible focus ring is applied via `:focus-visible` and can be themed with `--paw-color-focus-ring`.
- **Screen readers.** Roles, labels, and live regions are set correctly; `Tooltip` uses `aria-describedby`, `Field` links errors with `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`.
- **Motion.** Transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Portals.** `Tooltip` renders in a portal at the document root to avoid clipping.

---

## API surface

All components are exported from the package root:

```js
import {
  Button, Input, Textarea, Field,
  Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch,
  Select, Slider,
  Badge, Avatar, Tooltip,
} from 'paw';
```

Types are bundled:

```ts
import type { ButtonProps, TooltipProps } from 'paw';
```

---

## Browser support

Evergreen browsers: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (current and previous major versions). No polyfills required.

---

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome — especially new primitives that stay small.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourname/paw.git
cd paw
npm install
npm run dev      # start the docs playground
npm test         # run the test suite
npm run build    # build the package
```

Guidelines:

1. **Keep it small.** If a component needs configuration to be useful, it's probably two components.
2. **Accessibility is a requirement**, not a follow-up PR.
3. **No runtime dependencies.** Ever.
4. Add a Storybook story and a test for any new component.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full guide.

---

## Roadmap

- [ ] `Popover`
- [ ] `Tabs`
- [ ] `Toast`
- [ ] `Progress`
- [ ] `NumberInput`
- [ ] `Combobox`

---

## License

MIT © [your name](https://github.com/yourname)

---

*Made with 🐾 by the paw maintainers.*

# paw

> Tiny, accessible UI primitives for React. No runtime dependencies, no CSS-in-JS, no opinions you didn't ask for.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/paw.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/paw)
[![bundle size](https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/paw.svg)](https://bundlephobia.com/package/paw)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/paw.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![types](https://img.shields.io/npm/types/paw.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)

---

## Why paw?

- **12 primitives, that's it.** Everything you need to build a form or a toolbar, nothing you have to fight.
- **~4 kB gzipped** for the whole library. Tree-shakeable — pay only for what you import.
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** React is the only peer dependency.
- **Accessible by default.** Every interactive component ships with keyboard support, focus management, and correct ARIA.
- **Fully themeable.** Plain CSS custom properties — restyle without a build step or a theme provider.
- **TypeScript-first.** Written in TS, ships `.d.ts` files, works with plain JS too.

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install paw
# or
pnpm add paw
# or
yarn add paw
```

**Peer dependency:** `react >= 18`, `react-dom >= 18`.

```bash
npm install paw react react-dom
```

Import styles once, anywhere in your app:

```ts
import 'paw/styles.css';
```

---

## Quick start

```tsx
import { Button, Input, Checkbox } from 'paw';

export function SignupForm() {
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
      <Input id="email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />

      <Checkbox name="tos" defaultChecked>
        I accept the terms
      </Checkbox>

      <Button type="submit">Create account</Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

---

## The 12 primitives

| Component | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`Button`](#button) | Clickable action with variants, sizes, loading and icon slots. |
| [`Input`](#input) | Single-line text field with label, hint and error states. |
| [`Textarea`](#textarea) | Multi-line text field with auto-resize option. |
| [`Select`](#select) | Native-select styled consistently, with option groups. |
| [`Checkbox`](#checkbox) | Binary or indeterminate checkbox with hidden-native input. |
| [`RadioGroup`](#radiogroup) | Accessible radio group with roving focus. |
| [`Switch`](#switch) | Toggle for immediate on/off changes. |
| [`Badge`](#badge) | Small status pill for labels and counts. |
| [`Avatar`](#avatar) | Image or initials avatar with fallback. |
| [`Spinner`](#spinner) | Indeterminate loading indicator. |
| [`Tooltip`](#tooltip) | Hover/focus tooltip with positioning. |
| [`Divider`](#divider) | Horizontal or vertical rule with optional label. |

---

## Components

### Button

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={save}>Save</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | Visual style. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control height and padding. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and disables interaction. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches to the container width. |
| `startIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered before the label. |
| `endIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered after the label. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | Native button type. |

All other native `<button>` props are supported, and the ref forwards to the DOM node.

---

### Input

```tsx
<Input label="Email" hint="We'll never share it." error="Required" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Visible label; also sets `aria-label` when omitted. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` | — | Helper text shown below the field. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — | Error message; switches the field to the error state. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control height. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state without a message. |

`label`, `hint` and `error` are wired up with `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` automatically.

---

### Textarea

```tsx
<Textarea label="Bio" rows={4} autoResize placeholder="Tell us about yourself" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Visible label. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` | — | Helper text. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — | Error message. |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Visible rows. |
| `autoResize` | `boolean` | `false` | Grows with its content. |

---

### Select

```tsx
<Select label="Plan" defaultValue="pro">
  <option value="free">Free</option>
  <option value="pro">Pro</option>
</Select>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |



```css
  --paw-color-text: #111827;
  --paw-color-muted: #6b7280;

  --paw-color-focus: #6d28d9;

  --paw-space-2: 8px;
  --paw-space-3: 12px;
  --paw-space-4: 16px;
```

````markdown
# paw 🐾

**Twelve small React UI primitives.** No opinions, no bloat.

- **12 components** — Button, IconButton, Badge, Avatar, Spinner, Progress, Divider, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Switch, Tooltip
- **Zero runtime dependencies** (React is a peer dependency)
- **~4 kB gzipped**, tree-shakeable ESM + CJS
- **Fully typed** — TypeScript declarations included
- **Accessible by default** — ARIA attributes, keyboard support, focus management
- **Themeable with CSS variables** — no runtime style engine, no context required

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install paw
# or
pnpm add paw
# or
yarn add paw
```

**Peer dependency:** `react >= 18`, `react-dom >= 18`

```bash
npm install paw react react-dom
```

---

## Quick start

```tsx
import { Button, Badge, Input } from 'paw';
import 'paw/styles.css';

export function SignupForm() {
  return (
    <form onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <Badge tone="success" variant="soft">Beta</Badge>

      <Input
        label="Email"
        type="email"
        placeholder="you@example.com"
        hint="We'll never share it."
      />

      <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => alert('Hello!')}>
        Get started
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Every component accepts `className` and `style`, and forwards all remaining props to the underlying DOM element.

---

## The 12 components

| Component | Import | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Button | `import { Button } from 'paw'` | Clickable button with variants, sizes, loading state |
| IconButton | `import { IconButton } from 'paw'` | Square button for a single icon, requires a label |
| Badge | `import { Badge } from 'paw'` | Small status/count label |
| Avatar | `import { Avatar } from 'paw'` | Image with initials fallback |
| Spinner | `import { Spinner } from 'paw'` | Indeterminate loading indicator |
| Progress | `import { Progress } from 'paw'` | Determinate or indeterminate progress bar |
| Divider | `import { Divider } from 'paw'` | Horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labelled |
| Input | `import { Input } from 'paw'` | Single-line text field with label, hint, error |
| Textarea | `import { Textarea } from 'paw'` | Multi-line text field with optional character count |
| Checkbox | `import { Checkbox } from 'paw'` | Checkbox with label and description |
| Switch | `import { Switch } from 'paw'` | Toggle for immediate on/off settings |
| Tooltip | `import { Tooltip } from 'paw'` | Hover/focus tooltip wrapping any element |

---

## API reference

### Button

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md" loading disabled fullWidth onClick={fn}>
  Save changes
</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger' \| 'link'` | `'secondary'` | Visual style |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control size |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and blocks clicks |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches to the container width |
| `leftIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered before the label |
| `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered after the label |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | Native button type |

Also accepts all native `<button>` props except `type` defaults.

### IconButton

```tsx
<IconButton label="Close dialog" variant="ghost" onClick={close}>
  <CloseIcon />
</IconButton>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Accessible name (also used as `aria-label` and tooltip) |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | `'ghost'` | Visual style |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Control size |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button |

### Badge

```tsx
<Badge tone="warning" variant="soft">3 pending</Badge>
<Badge tone="success" dot>Online</Badge>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'info'` | `'neutral'` | Semantic color |
| `variant` | `'solid' \| 'soft' \| 'outline'` | `'soft'` | Visual style |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Badge size |
| `dot` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a leading status dot |

### Avatar

```tsx
<Avatar src="/ada.png" name="Ada Lovelace" size="lg" />
<Avatar name="Grace Hopper" shape="square" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image URL; falls back to initials on error |
| `name` | `string` | — | Used for initials and `alt` text |
| `alt` | `string` | `name` | Alternative text |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` | Avatar size |
| `shape` | `'circle' \| 'square'` | `'circle'` | Avatar shape |
| `onError` | `(e) => void` | — | Called when the image fails to load |

### Spinner

```tsx
<Spinner size="md" label="Loading results" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Spinner size |
| `label` | `string` | `'Loading'` | Screen-reader text |

### Progress

```tsx
<Progress value={64} max={100} label="Uploading" showValue />
<Progress label="Working" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | — | Current value (omit for indeterminate) |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Maximum value |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `!value` | Renders an indeterminate bar |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible label for the bar |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays `value / max` |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | Bar color |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Bar thickness |

### Divider

```tsx
<Divider />
<Divider orientation="vertical" />
<Divider label="or continue with" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Rule direction |
| `label` | `string` | — | Optional centered text |
| `spacing` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Margin around the rule |

### Input

```tsx
<Input
  label="Email"
  type="email"
  placeholder="you@example.com"
  hint="We'll never share it."
  error="Enter a valid email address."
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Field label (visually hidden if `hideLabel`) |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually hides the label but keeps it for a11y |
| `hint` | `string` | — | Helper text below the field |
| `error` | `string` | — | Error message; also sets `aria-invalid` |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Field size |
| `leadingIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered inside the field, before the input |
| `trailingIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered inside the field, after the input |

IDs are generated automatically with `useId` and wired to the label, hint, and error via `aria-describedby`.

### Textarea

```tsx
<Textarea label="Message" rows={4} maxLength={280} showCount />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Field label |
| `hint` | `string` | — | Helper text |
| `error` | `string` | — | Error message |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Visible rows |
| `maxLength` | `number` | — | Maximum characters |
| `showCount` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a live character counter |
| `resize` | `'none' \| 'vertical' \| 'both'` | `'vertical'` | Resize behavior |

### Checkbox

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Subscribe to updates" description="Monthly newsletter." />
<Checkbox label="Select all" indeterminate />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Label content |
| `description` | `string` | — | Secondary text under the label |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled checked state |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial state |
| `onChange` | `(e: ChangeEvent) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the mixed state |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the checkbox |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Control size |

### Switch

```tsx
<Switch
  label="Dark mode"
  description="Use a darker theme."
  checked={dark}
  onChange={(e) => setDark(e.target.checked)}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Label content |
| `description` | `string` | — | Secondary text under the label |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled state |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial state |
| `onChange` | `(e: ChangeEvent) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the switch |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Control size |

### Tooltip

```tsx
<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" placement="top">
  <Button variant="ghost">Copy</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `ReactNode` | **required** | Tooltip body |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` | `'top'` | Preferred position |
| `delay` | `number` | `200` | Open delay in ms (`0` to open instantly) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the tooltip |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled open state |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Controlled open handler |

The tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus, and closes on `Escape`.

---

## Theming

`paw` ships a plain stylesheet with no runtime CSS-in-JS. Override any CSS variable to restyle the library.

```css
@import 'paw/styles.css';

:root {
  --paw-color-primary: #4f46e5;
  --paw-color-primary-hover: #4338ca;
  --paw-color-danger: #dc2626;
  --paw-color-success: #16a34a;
  --paw-color-warning: #d97706;
  --paw-color-info: #0284c7;

  --paw-color-text: #0f172a;
  --paw-color-text-muted: #64748b;
  --paw-color-background: #ffffff;
  --paw-color-border: #e2e8f0;
  --paw-color-focus-ring: #4f46e5;

  --paw-radius-sm: 4px;
  --paw-radius-md: 8px;
  --paw-radius-lg: 12px;
  --paw-radius-full: 9999px;

  --paw-font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  --paw-font-size-sm: 0.875rem;
  --paw-font-size-md: 1rem;
  --paw-font-size-lg: 1.125rem;

  --paw-space-1: 0.25rem;
  --paw-space-2: 0.5rem;
  --paw-space-3: 0.75rem;
  --paw-space-4: 1rem;

  --paw-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
  --paw-shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.12);
}
```

### Dark mode

```css
[data-theme='dark'] {
  --paw-color-text: #e2e8f0;
  --paw-color-text-muted: #94a3b8;
  --paw-color-background: #0f172a;
  --paw-color-border: #1e293b;
  --paw-color-focus-ring: #818cf8;
}
```

### Per-component overrides

Every component exposes stable class names for targeted overrides:

```css
.paw-button--primary { /* ... */ }
.paw-input { /* ... */ }
.paw-checkbox__label { /* ... */ }
```

Class names follow the pattern `paw-<component>`, `paw-<component>__<element>`, and `paw-<component>--<variant>`.

---

## Accessibility

- All interactive components are keyboard navigable with visible focus rings.
- `IconButton` requires a `label`, which becomes its accessible name.
- `Input` and `Textarea` associate labels, hints, and errors with `aria-describedby`, and set `aria-invalid` when an error is present.
- `Switch` uses `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`.
- `Tooltip` content is linked with `aria-describedby` and dismisses on `Escape`.
- `Spinner` and `Progress` expose appropriate ARIA roles and values.
- Colors are never the only signal — errors include text, and badges can include a dot plus a label.

---

## TypeScript

Types are bundled. No `@types/` package needed.

```tsx
import type { ButtonProps, BadgeTone, Size } from 'paw';

const tone: BadgeTone = 'success';
const size: Size = 'md';
```

---

## Browser support

Evergreen browsers: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (current and previous two major versions).

---

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome!

1. Fork the repository and create a branch: `git checkout -b feat/my-component`
2. Install dependencies: `pnpm install`
3. Run the dev playground: `pnpm dev`
4. Run checks: `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`
5. Open a pull request describing the change and the use case.

New components should stay small, be fully typed, ship with tests and a docs example, and follow the existing API conventions (variants, sizes, `className`/`style` passthrough).

---

## License

MIT © paw contributors
````

# paw 🐾

A tiny, accessible collection of 12 unstyled-ish UI primitives for React. Zero runtime dependencies, tree-shakeable, and themable with CSS variables.

> **paw** — small primitives for big paws. Built with React 18+, TypeScript, and good defaults.

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install paw
# or
pnpm add paw
# or
yarn add paw
```

Peer dependencies: `react >= 18`, `react-dom >= 18`.

---

## Quick start

```tsx
import { Button, Input, Alert } from "paw";
import "paw/styles.css";

export function SignInForm() {
  return (
    <form>
      <Alert variant="info">Welcome back! Please sign in to continue.</Alert>

      <Input label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required />

      <Button type="submit" variant="primary" fullWidth>
        Sign in
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Every component is also available as a subpath import for optimal tree-shaking:

```tsx
import Button from "paw/Button";
```

---

## The 12 primitives

| Component | Import | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Button | `import { Button } from "paw"` | Clickable action with variants, sizes, and a loading state |
| Input | `import { Input } from "paw"` | Labelled text field with hint and error messaging |
| Checkbox | `import { Checkbox } from "paw"` | Tri-state-capable checkbox with a custom label |
| Radio | `import { Radio } from "paw"` | Single-choice radio input for grouped options |
| Switch | `import { Switch } from "paw"` | Immediate on/off toggle |
| Badge | `import { Badge } from "paw"` | Compact status pill or dot |
| Avatar | `import { Avatar } from "paw"` | Image with an initials fallback |
| Spinner | `import { Spinner } from "paw"` | Indeterminate loading indicator |
| Alert | `import { Alert } from "paw"` | Inline contextual message, optionally dismissible |
| Progress | `import { Progress } from "paw"` | Determinate progress bar |
| Tooltip | `import { Tooltip } from "paw"` | Hover/focus hint anchored to a trigger |
| Divider | `import { Divider } from "paw"` | Horizontal or vertical rule with optional label |

---

## Component API

### Button

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md" loading={false} onClick={handleClick}>
  Save changes
</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "ghost" \| "danger"` | `"primary"` | Visual style |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Control height and padding |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and disables interaction |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches to the width of the container |
| `leftIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered before the label |
| `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered after the label |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | `"button"` | Native button type |
| `as` | `ElementType` | `"button"` | Render as another element (e.g. `as="a"`) |

### Input

```tsx
<Input label="Email" hint="We'll never share it." error="That email looks off." />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Visible label, associated via `htmlFor` |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` | — | Helper text shown below the field |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — | Error message; also sets `aria-invalid` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Control height |
| `type` | `string` | `"text"` | Native input type |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Controlled or uncontrolled value |
| `onChange` | `(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the field |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required |
| `id` | `string` | generated | Input id used to wire label/description |

### Checkbox

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Subscribe to updates" defaultChecked />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled or uncontrolled state |
| `onChange` | `(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the mixed state |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Label text |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the input |
| `name` | `string` | — | Native name attribute |

### Radio

```tsx
<Radio name="plan" value="pro" label="Pro" defaultChecked />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | **required** | Groups radios together |
| `value` | `string` | — | Value submitted with the form |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled state |
| `onChange` | `(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Label text |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the input |

### Switch

```tsx
<Switch label="Dark mode" checked={dark} onChange={setDark} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled or uncontrolled state |
| `onChange` | `(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | — | Change handler |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Label text |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` | Track size |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the switch |

### Badge

```tsx
<Badge variant="success" dot>Live</Badge>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"neutral" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info"` | `"neutral"` | Color scheme |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` | Badge size |
| `dot` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a status dot instead of a filled pill |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Badge content |

### Avatar

```tsx
<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" src="/ada.png" size="lg" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image URL; falls back to initials on error |
| `alt` | `string` | `""` | Alternative text (empty when initials are used) |
| `name` | `string` | — | Used to derive initials fallback |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"md"` | Avatar diameter |
| `shape` | `"circle" \| "square"` | `"circle"` | Border radius style |

### Spinner

```tsx
<Spinner size="md" label="Loading…" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Spinner diameter |
| `color` | `string` | `currentColor` | CSS color |
| `label` | `string` | `"Loading"` | Screen-reader label |

### Alert

```tsx
<Alert variant="warning" title="Careful" onDismiss={dismiss}>
  Your session expires in 5 minutes.
</Alert>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `"info"` | Color scheme |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Optional bold heading |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | auto | Overrides the default variant icon |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | — | Renders a close button when provided |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Message body |

### Progress

```tsx
<Progress value={64} max={100} showValue label="Upload progress" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | **required** | Current value |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Upper bound |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `"primary"` | Bar color |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Bar thickness |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays the percentage next to the label |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the bar |

### Tooltip

```tsx
<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" placement="top">
  <button>Copy</button>
</Tooltip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `ReactNode` | **required** | Tooltip body |
| `placement` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | `"top"` | Preferred position |
| `delay` | `number` | `200` | Open delay in milliseconds |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the tooltip |
| `children` | `ReactElement` | **required** | The trigger element |

### Divider

```tsx
<Divider label="or" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Rule direction |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Optional centered label |
| `spacing` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Margin around the rule |

---

## Theming

paw ships a single stylesheet built entirely on CSS custom properties. Override any token in your own CSS:

```css
:root {
  --paw-color-primary: #7c3aed;
  --paw-color-primary-hover: #6d28d9;
  --paw-color-danger: #dc2626;
  --paw-color-success: #16a34a;
  --paw-color-warning: #d97706;
  --paw-color-info: #0284c7;

  --paw-color-text: #111827;
  --paw-color-muted: #6b7280;
  --paw-color-border: #e5e7eb;
  --paw-color-surface: #ffffff;
  --paw-color-focus-ring: #7c3aed;

  --paw-radius-sm: 4px;
  --paw-radius-md: 8px;
  --paw-radius-full: 9999px;

  --paw-space-1: 4px;
  --paw-space-2: 8px;
  --paw-space-3: 12px;
  --paw-space-4: 16px;
  --paw-space-5: 24px;

  --paw-font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --paw-font-size-sm: 13px;
  --paw-font-size-md: 14px;
  --paw-font-size-lg: 16px;

  --paw-transition: 150ms ease;
}
```

Dark mode example:

```css
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --paw-color-text: #f3f4f6;
  --paw-color-muted: #9ca3af;
  --paw-color-border: #374151;
  --paw-color-surface: #111827;
}
```

---

## Accessibility

- All form controls are real `<input>` elements — keyboard and screen-reader behaviour comes for free.
- Labels are programmatically associated with their inputs; `hint` and `error` are wired via `aria-describedby`.
- `aria-invalid` is set automatically when an `error` is present.
- `Spinner`, `Progress`, and `Tooltip` expose correct ARIA roles and names.
- Visible focus rings are never removed.
- Every component respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

---

## TypeScript

Types are bundled and exported:

```tsx
import type { ButtonProps, InputProps, BadgeVariant } from "paw";

const variant: BadgeVariant = "success";
```

---

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome and tiny PRs are especially appreciated 🐾

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourname/paw.git
cd paw
pnpm install
pnpm dev        # storybook-ish playground
pnpm test       # vitest + testing-library
pnpm lint
pnpm build
```

### Adding a primitive

1. Create `src/components/<Name>/<Name>.tsx` with a colocated `<Name>.test.tsx`.
2. Export it from `src/index.ts`.
3. Add a docs page under `src/components/<Name>/<Name>.mdx`.
4. Run `pnpm lint && pnpm test`.

Guidelines: no runtime dependencies, no inline styles (use CSS variables), full keyboard support, and tests for keyboard and ARIA behaviour.

---

## License

MIT © paw contributors

# 🐾 paw

> Tiny, tree-shakeable React primitives. Small paws, big impressions.

`paw` is a collection of **12 small, unstyled-by-default UI primitives** for React. Every component is
focused, composable, and accessible out of the box — the kind of building blocks you reach for
again and again.

- **12 primitives** — nothing more, nothing less
- **Tree-shakeable** — import only what you use
- **TypeScript-first** — full types for every component
- **Zero runtime dependencies** (other than React)
- **Themable** — CSS custom properties, no build-time theme config

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install paw
# or
pnpm add paw
# or
yarn add paw
```

**Peer dependencies**

```bash
npm install react react-dom
```

| Package | Version |
| ------- | ------- |
| `react` | `^18.0.0` \|\| `^19.0.0` |
| `react-dom` | `^18.0.0` \|\| `^19.0.0` |

---

## Quick start

```tsx
import { Button, Badge } from 'paw';

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Button variant="primary" size="sm">
      Save changes
      <Badge tone="success">New</Badge>
    </Button>
  );
}
```

Or import a single component to keep your bundle lean:

```tsx
import Button from 'paw/Button';
```

---

## The 12 primitives

| Component | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| [`Avatar`](#avatar) | Image or initials with a graceful fallback. |
| [`Badge`](#badge) | Small status label or count indicator. |
| [`Button`](#button) | Clickable action with variants and loading state. |
| [`Checkbox`](#checkbox) | Controlled or uncontrolled boolean input. |
| [`Chip`](#chip) | Compact tag for filters and selections. |
| [`Divider`](#divider) | Horizontal or vertical rule with optional label. |
| [`Icon`](#icon) | Renders an SVG icon from a bundled or custom path. |
| [`Input`](#input) | Text field with label, hint, and error states. |
| [`Progress`](#progress) | Determinate or indeterminate progress bar. |
| [`Spinner`](#spinner) | Loading indicator with accessible labels. |
| [`Switch`](#switch) | Toggle for immediate on/off settings. |
| [`Tooltip`](#tooltip) | Hover/focus hint anchored to a trigger. |

---

### Avatar

Displays a user image, falling back to initials when the image is missing or fails to load.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from 'paw';

<Avatar src="/me.png" alt="Ada Lovelace" name="Ada Lovelace" size="lg" />
<Avatar name="Grace Hopper" shape="square" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image URL. |
| `alt` | `string` | `""` | Alternative text (empty hides the image from AT). |
| `name` | `string` | — | Used to derive initials for the fallback. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"md"` | Rendered size. |
| `shape` | `"circle" \| "square"` | `"circle"` | Avatar shape. |
| `onError` | `(event) => void` | — | Called when the image fails to load. |

---

### Badge

A small label for statuses, counts, and metadata.

```tsx
import { Badge } from 'paw';

<Badge tone="success">Active</Badge>
<Badge tone="danger" variant="solid">3</Badge>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `tone` | `"neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `"neutral"` | Semantic color. |
| `variant` | `"soft" \| "solid" \| "outline"` | `"soft"` | Visual style. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"sm"` | Badge size. |
| `dot` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a dot instead of children. |

---

### Button

The workhorse. Supports variants, sizes, loading, and full-width layouts.

```tsx
import { Button } from 'paw';

<Button variant="primary">Primary</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" size="lg">Ghost</Button>
<Button loading disabled>Saving…</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "ghost" \| "danger"` | `"primary"` | Visual style. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Button size. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and disables interaction. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches to the container width. |
| `iconLeft` / `iconRight` | `ReactNode` | — | Optional adornments. |
| `as` | `ElementType` | `"button"` | Render as a different element (e.g. `as="a"`). |

---

### Checkbox

A styled checkbox with a label, description, and indeterminate state.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from 'paw';

<Checkbox label="Email me about product updates" defaultChecked />
<Checkbox label="Select all" indeterminate />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled or uncontrolled state. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the mixed state. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Visible label text. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — | Secondary text under the label. |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | Change handler. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the input. |

---

### Chip

An interactive tag used for filters, tags, and selections.

```tsx
import { Chip } from 'paw';

<Chip onClose={() => remove('react')}>react ×</Chip>
<Chip selected onClick={select}>All</Chip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies the selected style. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Shows a remove button. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | — | Makes the chip interactive. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — | Leading icon. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables interaction. |

---

### Divider

A rule that separates content, optionally with a centered label.

```tsx
import { Divider } from 'paw';

<Divider />
<Divider orientation="vertical" />
<Divider label="or continue with" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Direction of the rule. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Optional label rendered in the middle. |
| `spacing` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Space around the divider. |

---

### Icon

Renders an inline SVG icon. Icons inherit `currentColor` and scale with `font-size`.

```tsx
import { Icon } from 'paw';

<Icon name="check" size={20} />
<Icon name="paw" variant="filled" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `name` | `IconName` | — | Name of a bundled icon. |
| `size` | `number \| string` | `"1em"` | Icon dimensions. |
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "filled"` | `"outline"` | Icon style. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible label; omit for decorative icons. |

---

### Input

A text field with label, hint, error message, and optional adornments.

```tsx
import { Input } from 'paw';

<Input
  label="Email"
  placeholder="you@example.com"
  hint="We'll never share it."
  error="That email looks invalid."
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Field label. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` | — | Helper text below the field. |
| `error` | `string` | — | Error message; also sets `aria-invalid`. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Field size. |
| `prefix` / `suffix` | `ReactNode` | — | Content inside the field. |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Field state. |

---

### Progress

A progress bar for tasks, uploads, and completion.

```tsx
import { Progress } from 'paw';

<Progress value={64} label="Uploading" />
<Progress indeterminate />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `value` | `number` | — | Current value (0–100). Omit for indeterminate. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Maximum value. |
| `tone` | `"info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `"info"` | Bar color. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Bar thickness. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible label for the bar. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays the numeric percentage. |

---

### Spinner

A lightweight loading indicator.

```tsx
import { Spinner } from 'paw';

<Spinner size="sm" />
<Spinner label="Loading data…" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Spinner size. |
| `label` | `string` | `"Loading"` | Screen-reader label. |
| `color` | `string` | `currentColor` | Custom color. |

---

### Switch

A toggle for settings that apply immediately.

```tsx
import { Switch } from 'paw';

<Switch label="Dark mode" checked={dark} onChange={setDark} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `checked` / `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Controlled or uncontrolled state. |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | Change handler. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Label text. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — | Secondary text. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` | Switch size. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the switch. |

---

### Tooltip

A hint that appears on hover or focus.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'paw';

<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard">
  <button>Copy</button>
</Tooltip>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `content` | `ReactNode` | — | Tooltip body. |
| `placement` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | `"top"` | Position relative to the trigger. |
| `delay` | `number` | `200` | Open delay in milliseconds. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the tooltip. |

---

## Theming

`paw` ships with sensible defaults and exposes every visual decision as a CSS custom property.
Override them anywhere in your app:

```css
:root {
  --paw-color-primary: #6366f1;
  --paw-color-primary-hover: #4f46e5;
  --paw-color-success: #16a34a;
  --paw-color-warning: #f59e0b;
  --paw-color-danger: #dc2626;

  --paw-color-text: #111827;
  --paw-color-muted: #6b7280;
  --paw-color-surface: #ffffff;
  --paw-color-border: #e5e7eb;

  --paw-radius-sm: 4px;
  --paw-radius-md: 8px;
  --paw-radius-lg: 12px;
  --paw-radius-full: 9999px;

  --paw-font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --paw-font-size-sm: 0.875rem;
  --paw-font-size-md: 1rem;
  --paw-font-size-lg: 1.125rem;

  --paw-space-sm: 0.375rem;
  --paw-space-md: 0.625rem;
  --paw-space-lg: 1rem;

  --paw-shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
  --paw-transition: 150ms ease;
}
```

### Dark mode

```css
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --paw-color-text: #f9fafb;
  --paw-color-muted: #9ca3af;
  --paw-color-surface: #1f2937;
  --paw-color-border: #374151;
}
```

---

## Accessibility

Every primitive is built with accessibility in mind:

- Semantic HTML elements and native form controls wherever possible
- Visible focus rings that respect `:focus-visible`
- ARIA roles, states, and relationships applied automatically
- Tooltips and hints are announced to assistive technology
- All interactive components are keyboard navigable and support `disabled` correctly
- Color is never the only signal — states are also conveyed by shape, icon, or text

---
